desc:
Welcome to Yatzy! 🎲 The ultimate multiplayer dice and classic board game on Roblox. Whether you call it Yahtzee, Yatzy, or Yacht, test your luck in this fun, competitive tabletop party game!

Roll the dice and push your luck against friends, or practice solo in our 3D dice simulator. If you love casual tabletop games or classic family board games, pull up a chair!

✨ FEATURES:
• 🎲 3 Game Modes: Classic turn-based Yatzy, Liar's Dice & Farkle!
• 🤝 Multiplayer Board Game: Hang out in 4-player lobbies with friends.
• 🤖 Solo Practice: Play offline-style against AI bots!
• 🏆 Global Leaderboards: Compete for the highest dice game score & most wins.
• 🎨 Unlockables: Earn rewards to get custom 3D dice skins and map backgrounds.

👍 Please Like & Favorite the game to support future updates! ⭐

🎁 Join Conso Games for updates & bug reporting:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/168925227/Conso-Games
